# 获取帮助 / Getting Support

## 中文

- **使用问题、配置咨询、想法讨论**：请到 [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/xiaonerner0821/prismsearch/discussions) 提问。
  提问前可以先看看 [README](../README.zh-CN.md) 的「常见问题」，并运行 `npm run build && node scripts/check-cwd-config.mjs` 确认实际加载的配置。
- **Bug 报告、功能请求、新引擎建议**：请到 [Issues](https://github.com/xiaonerner0821/prismsearch/issues/new/choose) 按模板提交，
  附上版本号（`npx prismsearch --version`）、Node.js 版本、操作系统、复现步骤和相关日志（注意去掉密钥与令牌）。
- **安全问题**：**不要**公开提 Issue，请按 [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) 私下报告。

## English

- **Usage questions, configuration help, ideas**: ask in [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/xiaonerner0821/prismsearch/discussions).
  The FAQ in the [README](../README.md) and `npm run build && node scripts/check-cwd-config.mjs` (shows which config was actually loaded) answer many common questions.
- **Bug reports, feature requests, new engine proposals**: open an [Issue](https://github.com/xiaonerner0821/prismsearch/issues/new/choose) using the templates.
  Include the version (`npx prismsearch --version`), Node.js version, OS, reproduction steps and relevant logs (with keys and tokens removed).
- **Security vulnerabilities**: do **not** open a public issue — report privately as described in [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
